description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Switches the automatic first DM reply for messaging-ad leads on or off (firstReplyEnabled) and sets its text (firstReplyText, up to 600 characters; null uses the greeting; omit to keep it). Needs ads:manage and an owner or admin of the brand. Each new conversation gets it once, only inside the platform window. Free: nothing is charged. Confirm the text with the user first: it is sent to real people.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/lead-replies.)

brandId.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands, or `personal`. Omitted: the key's brand (a brand-bound key) or the owner's active brand.

firstReplyText.description: Omitted: keep the stored text. Null or empty: use the greeting.

name: ads_lead_replies_set
title: Set the lead response rule
